deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 2 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Location In Chassis\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 2` output filtered to the `Location In Chassis` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; reads the named field but does not bind it to a specific Type 2 record or Type 3 chassis and hides errors.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds topology mapping and recovery but incorrectly treats supplied mapping/approval as manual core execution.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; considers the read agent-runnable after variable provisioning without topology-specific safeguards.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify the Location In Chassis metadata of the intended SMBIOS Type 2 baseboard matches the approved Type 2-to-Type 3 physical/topology mapping and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 2 and correlated Type 3 records, identify the intended board/chassis pair from the approved BOM/topology, compare Location In Chassis with that mapping, perform the approved reboot and repeat on the same records.
manual_activity: A user approves the target board/chassis mapping and reboot plan. The metadata collection, correlation, comparison and persistence check are software-controlled.
required_inputs: Expected Location In Chassis and physical/topology reference
Type 2 board and Type 3 chassis identity/BOM mapping
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and preserve full Type 2/Type 3 output plus errors.
Do not assume the first board or chassis record and do not accept any non-empty location as correct.
Treat the value as firmware metadata; do not claim it independently proves physical placement.
Stop on ambiguous correlation, placeholder value, topology drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect and correlate all relevant Type 2/Type 3 records, compare the selected Location In Chassis with the approved topology and repeat after reboot.
Do not alter DMI, assert unobserved physical placement or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the board/chassis identity and expected physical/topology mapping.
Resolve metadata-versus-assembly discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The named field is relevant, but grep context loses record and chassis provenance, stderr is discarded and insecure transport assumptions are present.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive unfiltered Type 2 and Type 3 output with tool/errors, correlate handles and approved BOM identity, then extract Location In Chassis from the mapped board record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source field, linked Type 2 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture all board and chassis records, retain handles and identity fields, bind the target board to the approved assembly location, then compare the exact normalized location on the same mapping before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 2/Type 3 server platforms, especially multi-board chassis.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved platform topology/BOM recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit cross-record and physical-assembly provenance without rewriting the source field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; physical-placement proof remains outside this metadata-only case unless separately required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct string can still be stale firmware data if assembly provenance is wrong.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its own location naming convention or supported absence, but must identify the exact board/chassis records and retain the physical/topology reference used.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected location, board/chassis/BOM mapping and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 2/Type 3 records plus correlated location comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, generic information procedure and persistence criterion consistently define Type 2 location metadata validation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and safe read path are clear; topology and expected-value inputs affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the field read but adds record/chassis correlation and visible errors.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves topology safeguards while correcting classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under the locked rule that supplying SPEC or approval is not manual core activity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates metadata correctness from any separate physical inspection claim.

review_improvement: Prevents a Location In Chassis value from an unrelated baseboard or an unverified free-form string from satisfying the case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source tests SMBIOS metadata, not an explicit human visual inspection. With an approved topology reference, the core read/compare/reboot flow is automatable.
